translation.name: YAUBADA BONANA VEYAO IVAGUNA Bona Iduna

book.name: 1 KOLINITA
book.title: Folo yana leta nagona KOLINITA tovetumagana agaidiya

content: Badi miKolinita yadi vetumagana keke gidatubuga.

Tobohiyakweyao, omi vaita weꞋoweꞋo amine, keke Yaubada wadahalamane-hagihagiyeni. Tuwaina buye kamiyami ana toveya keke akufaiweya kaliva nuwadi AluꞋaluwa Mahalina againe hise-moꞋena ma amine agaimiya gadalaumamala. Au dibumi koyona ana nuwanuwa againe aimo wamiyami faꞋina, omi vaita weꞋoweꞋo yami vetumagana keke gidatubuga-ma galumamalemi.

Huhu fwefweya hihuhuna-ma meda anafaiweya yaku laumamala omi agaimiya. Keke aꞋa oꞋolina lakahidiyao hiꞋauꞋana-ma amine Yaubada yana nuwahinage yaku laumamala againe gadaveꞋami, faꞋina keke amifata. Kadu tova adamoya aꞋa oꞋolina keke amifata.

Omi aimo babi ana nuwanuwa amine wahuluhuluva. WaꞋitami, aimo wagagaꞋumaꞋuma kadu buye wavekwavekwageya faꞋina makewaꞋe babi ana nuwanuwa amine wahuluhuluva. E, badi Yaubada keke hidahalamaneni-ma amine wadedewadewa.
Mena dewa saꞋeyana ma tufoimi wagayo, “Iya Folo yana kaliva,” kadu tufoimi wagayo, “Iya Afolosi yana kaliva.” Hida huluvai-nadi badi Yaubada keke hidahalamaneni-ma yadi huluva amine.
Yaubada bonana ana tolaumamala vaita tofaha amine.

Bana mena Afolosi vaita hakwaꞋadi? Iya Folo vaita hakwaꞋadi-yo faꞋimeya wavekwavekwageya? Ime kaliva kabiꞋomeyao, ama egana tofaisewa ada gavaimi faisewa saꞋeyana saꞋeyana Kaiwabu givehimeyema, medede amine afifaisewa. Ime omi hinafamiya afaisewa faꞋina, Kaiwabu againe wavetumagana.
WaꞋita, yama faisewa vaita faha amine. Iya otova aseꞋasemiya gafahana, bana Afolosi yana kivetuvetunu againe faha giꞋitaꞋitaveꞋavina tu bana Yaubada anakaibe aꞋa gikivetubugina.
FaꞋina bana otova ana tofaha kadu faha ana toꞋitaveꞋavina badi keke kikaiwabudiyao. Bana Yaubada anakaibe kikaiwabuna faꞋina Bana aꞋa gikivetubugina.
Bana otova ana tofaha kadu faha ana toꞋitaveꞋavina yadi kaiwabu leleleya. Kaliva saꞋeyana saꞋeyana yadi faisewa amine Yaubada adi laufata ginaveledi.
Meda ime amaꞋiselu Yaubada yana tofaisewa Bana buye afififaisewa. Vaita Yaubada yana faha omiꞋiyao. Kadu vaita Yaubada yana manuwaꞋiyogoyogona omiꞋiyao.
Yaubada bonana ana tovehawala vaita manuwa
ana toꞋaiyogona amine.

Tu Yaubada yana manuwaꞋiyogoyogona faꞋina aku vehimeya giveleku be yana veluga againe omi yana manuwa ami aiyogona gavebutuna. Iya gamidilumamalemi higa vaita toꞋaiyogona halamanina amine manuwa ana ogola gakivemididina tu mali kaliva yadi vehawala againe lumalumana hiyogoyogona. Omi tovehawala wanaꞋitaveꞋavimi be vehawala vaita yowana oꞋolina againe manuwa wanayogo-hagihagiyena.

Bana mena holiliꞋabi ma ahe gakivemididina higa Yesu Keliso au yami vetumagana luluna. Keke tamo hakwadi mali holiliꞋabi anafaiweya ginakivemididini. Yaubada yana manuwa ana holiliꞋabi au saꞋeyanaga, higa Yesu Keliso.

Badi Yaubada bonana ana tovehawala vaita manuwa ana toꞋaiyogona amine. Tufoidi yadi vehawala againe vaita kasikasi, tutuwana, kainumula againe manuwa hidayogoyogoni. Tufoidi ma vaita mulumulu, dikwadikwa, mobo againe hidayogoyogoni.

Aimo vedewayauga ana tova kaliva moyaꞋaida yada faisewa ginaꞋivemogatalina be yamumuna o kaꞋi koyona amine moyaꞋaidi hinaꞋitana. FaꞋina vedewayauga ana toveya aiꞋalaꞋalata yada faisewa ginaꞋalahiluvaluvana, kaꞋi oꞋolina o fwalelena amine kayogona.
Hai kaliva yana vehawala tunutunugina ma aiꞋalaꞋalata mena yana iyogoyogona ginaꞋalaꞋunaunana medema ana laufata ginavaina.

Tu hai kaliva yana iyogoyogona ginaꞋala-Ꞌowona medema yana faisewa ginayawowola, ada keke laufata ginavaini. Tu bana tauna keke ginabwavi, au kaliva lokoloko manuwa giꞋalaꞋalahina againe hiluluvemauga amine, Yaubada bana kalivai-nadi ginalugolegolena.
Omi Yaubada yana manuwa amine.
Tobohiyakweyao, omi keke maꞋi wadahalamaneni? Omi Yaubada yana manuwa amine, ada Yaubada AluꞋaluwana nuwahinagemiya giveꞋabaga.
KaꞋi tamo hakwadi Yaubada yana manuwa ginakivekoyona digo, Yaubada bana kalivai-nadi ginaluyawelina. FaꞋina Yaubada yana manuwa au abaga sevesevehailana, ada omiꞋiyao Bana yana manuwa.
Keke kaliva adi egana kanayakahini.
Keke taumiyao agaimiya wanaveꞋalololo. KaꞋi tamo hakwadi omi tovetumagana agaimiya unuwanuwa vaita o tonuwahuya, au tomiyababi matadiya udavekwavakwava-yo Yaubada matane udavetonuwahuya.
FaꞋina tomiyababi Yaubada keke hidahalamaneni-ma yadi nuwahuya vaita iyohoyoho amine Yaubada matane. E, Veyao Tuwaina ana buki gigahe amine gigayo,

content.text: Babi ana tonuwahuya aikaunuwanuwadiyao nonogana Yaubada agedi givebahina be yadi nuwahuya vaita iyohoyoho amine ginaseyemaunena.

content: Kadu gahe velugana buki-nadi againe gigahe gigayo,

content.text: Kaiwabu tonuwahuya yadi nuwanuwa gihalamane-Ꞌowona, higa mema yogo ma gaitoma-kawowo.

content: Yaubada babi ana tonuwahuya faꞋidiya hidedemi gigahe faꞋina, keke tamo hakwadi agaimiya kaliva adi egana unayakahini vaita faꞋidiya unaꞋalatutula. WaꞋita, gaitoma moyaꞋaina au mema yami gaitoma,

higa iya Folo ada badi Afolosi be Fita, kadu hida babi ana gaitoma, kadu yawaimi ana aiyeta, kadu alika ana tova, kadu gaitoma moyaꞋaina tova adamoya gidadauda amanadi, kadu gaitoma moyaꞋaina aimo tova mulina ginalakayemu amanadi. E, mena gaitoma moyaꞋaina omi yami gaitoma, be ami veluga faꞋina.
Tu omiꞋiyao ma Keliso yana gaitoma, ada kadu Keliso Yaubada yana gaitoma.
